events.what: Top-down bullet-hell combat ends as the pink projectiles vanish and the camera sweeps down to an angled view of the heart-shaped boss platform.
The camera holds steady on the glowing pink heart-shaped boss ('The Warden') while dialogue subtitles play at the bottom.
The camera cuts to a behind-the-back view of the glowing blue player ship facing the boss down the track as the conversation concludes.
Large yellow text 'LANES KEPT / The Warden stands down' appears in the center of the screen while the camera pulls back overhead.
The banner fades out; the camera slowly drifts backward along the track as final narration subtitles appear and then fade.

emptyRegions.why: The static camera framing leaves vast stretches of dark starfield and empty track around the central boss platform with no movement.
The over-the-shoulder angle leaves the right half of the screen mostly empty black space and static track lines.

deadTime.carriedBy: Voice acting from The Warden and the Onboarding Assistant, accompanied by a high-pitched ambient drone.
Voice acting from Pilot #0122, the Onboarding Assistant, and The Warden.
Calm synth music and deep male narration (Lane Authority Briefing).

heard.what: Electronic combat sound effects and the female voice of the Onboarding Assistant finishing a sentence.
The Warden (loud, manic male voice) shouting in disbelief.
Onboarding Assistant (calm, robotic female voice) announcing recall over a rising high-pitched electronic tone.
The Warden shouting defiantly over the sustained high-pitched tone.
Onboarding Assistant speaking again while the high-pitched ring continues.
Pilot #0122 (quiet, resolute female voice) speaking a short phrase.
Onboarding Assistant speaking and glitching out as the high-pitched tone stops.
The Warden laughing maniacally and shouting approval.
Warm, melodic synth music with a steady beat plays while a deep, calm male narrator (Lane Authority Briefing) speaks from 38.8s to 50.0s.

answer.payoff: Yes, the resolution directly rewards the player's pacifist achievement—dodging every attack without firing back—by having the boss spare and free them. While the voice acting and music shift make the narrative consequence feel earned, the nearly 35 seconds of completely static camera angles during the dialogue dull the visual excitement.
answer.uncertainty: Nothing significant; the HUD, subtitles, and audio clearly explain the context of the pacifist boss clear.
